bear_assumptions: About USD 500 million of forward revenue at 5x enterprise value/revenue, USD 380 million of net financial resources and 70 million diluted shares as growth slows, adjusted breakeven slips, cash burn and dilution persist, and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: About USD 550 million of forward revenue at 8x enterprise value/revenue, USD 430 million of net financial resources and 69 million diluted shares as low-20s growth moderates, gross margin remains above 50%, and profitability improves gradually with continuing stock compensation.
bull_assumptions: About USD 600 million of forward revenue at 11x enterprise value/revenue, USD 470 million of net financial resources and 68 million diluted shares as DSPS and NGS sustain strong growth, the Anthropic work leads to repeat business, Q4 breakeven becomes durable positive cash economics, and dilution slows.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and revised scenarios clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if Q4 adjusted-EBITDA breakeven slips without a credible temporary cause, Anthropic evaluations fail to convert into repeatable disclosed economics, revenue growth or gross margin materially undershoots guidance, operating cash use accelerates, dilution offsets operating progress, or the platform loses cost, quality, or turnaround-time competitiveness.
